source_datasets.notes: Table 11 prints 519 local leaf rows (including the ten Abidjan communes, joined through the census's printed Total-Ville ABIDJAN aggregate) and department, region, district, and national totals across paired sheets. The 16 religion categories sum to the ordinary-household basis; the displayed resident total additionally includes collective-household residents and people without housing. In 31 local rows the printed category sum exceeds the printed resident total by one or two people; these source-arithmetic discrepancies are shipped unchanged and disclosed (reconciliation-verification.md).
